item.title: Indiana extends health plan enrollment deadline amid high engagement
item.description: The Indiana Family and Social Services Administration has extended the open enrollment period for the Healthy Indiana Plan and PathWays programs through Dec. 24, 2025, to give eligible Hoosiers more time to choose a health plan.

item.title: Carmel honors parks supporter with forest named in her honor
item.description: Sue Dillon, a founding member of the nonprofit Citizens for Greenspace, was honored by the Carmel Clay Board of Parks and Recreation for her pivotal role in establishing the Carmel Clay Parks & Recreation department. Central Park Woodlands will be renamed Susannah H. Dillon Woods.

item.title: QB Daniel Jones posts message to Colts fans on Instagram
item.description: Colts quarterback Daniel Jones made a post on Instagram thanking his teammates, coaches and fans for their support this season.

item.title: Indiana Senate rejects Trump-backed redrawing of congressional maps
item.description: Indiana voters will not face new congressional districts in 2026 after the state Senate rejected the proposed maps, marking the first time Republican state lawmakers have rejected Trump's demands for more GOP-friendly maps.

item.title: Indianapolis police arrests 2 after fatal high-speed crash
item.description: Two men were arrested in Indianapolis after a black Mustang and a pickup truck on Thursday morning crashed, resulting in the death of the truck driver. Police believe the crash was caused by high-speed activity.

item.title: Snow accumulation Thursday night, more snow Saturday with frigid air by Sunday | Dec. 11, 2025
item.description: A winter weather advisory is in effect until 10 a.m. Dec. 12, 2025, for parts of central Indiana, with snow accumulation expected Thursday night into Friday morning. Next: additional snow on Saturday, and a hefty shot of arctic air by Sunday.
